name: cm-customerportal
description: Critical Manufacturing Customer Portal — check support tickets, draft new tickets and replies, review licenses and upcoming expirations, explain customer environment deployment logs, and search known issues and enhancement requests, acting as the signed-in portal user.

interface.shortDescription: Critical Manufacturing Customer Portal: tickets, licenses, environments, known issues
interface.longDescription: Works with the Critical Manufacturing Customer Portal as the signed-in user: check support tickets and their conversations, draft new tickets and replies for submission in the portal, review licenses and which expire in the next 30/60/90 days, explain failed customer environment deployments from their logs, and search known issues and enhancement requests.
defaultPrompt: Show my open Customer Portal tickets.
Which of our CM licenses expire in the next 90 days?
Why did the last deployment of our production environment fail?
